integrity: Unrestricted proofs use elementary prime-power order lifting and two linear Fermat-quotient constraints; finite scripts corroborate only bounded cases. Priority comparison includes accessible primary texts and known risks.
scientific_limitations: Explicit local lift count conditional on the finite-field primitive seeds; does not count those seeds in closed form. The exact finite-field existence classification is quoted from Cohen et al., and the exceptional cases are checked directly. No claim of historical completeness or independent certification.
title: Exact simultaneous primitive-root lifting for reciprocal Laurent maps
